entries.title: A tidier workshop, clearer orders
notes: Welcome back! We have tidied the workshop’s menus and event pages so it is easier to find what you need. Claim 10 rubies below as a thank-you. Earlier mail and unclaimed gifts are still available.

Events now have four sections: Current run, Results, Rewards and Story. Check your live delivery progress, revisit the previous rush, browse rewards or replay conversations without scrolling through everything at once. The right-hand Events panel keeps your compact supply pouch and Brew controls.

Free outfits stay free. The two free themed outfits remain visible among the overnight event previews, but can no longer consume an earned costume choice. Spend a choice on an eligible unowned reward outfit or take a permanent Costume Voucher instead. Existing outfits, vouchers and pending choices are preserved.

Event supplies now use the purple tutorial herb on the conveyor and in the pouch. The brewed event potion keeps its bottle artwork. Catching supplies, brewing and delivering still work as separate actions; ordinary brewing remains available between event bottles.

The potion book’s illustrated spread is now a quick brewing reference. Read full lore opens the complete entry, with original notes, expanded lore, reviews, supplier notes and enhancement tables intact. Pio and Tia’s extra comments still unlock at MAX. The reader now prepares only the entry you selected rather than the whole family.

Potion records now link directly to their mastery achievement instead of repeating another achievement progress card. Original achievement details show their requirement once, with prerequisites and claim rewards still available. Tiered achievement replacement is unchanged.

Commission cards focus on the customer, their reason for ordering, the exact potion and the reward. Shared rules appear once at the top: one active commission, no acceptance fee and no deadline. Potion requirements, delivery quantities and payouts are unchanged.

Navigation is clearer: the tavern menu entry is labeled Expeditions, and Visitor Expeditions uses the tavern icon on its title card too. When a traveler’s potion is ready, the main delivery action names the recipient. Existing event, traveler, commission and sale priorities are unchanged.

Costume origins are small labels rather than extra disabled buttons. The unavailable Contest tile is hidden until it offers a playable activity. The sidebar points to Help instead of repeating its tutorial, and shared headers keep Back, titles and Close in one place.

Historical events remain in the read-only archive, including the Season 2 promotion. Their banners, saved Miracle Solution and previously earned outfits are retained while migration waits. The unused old event gallery no longer sits behind the new event interface.

Behind the counter, chest displays share the same availability information, event updates use one scheduled loop, and arrival/event dialogue shares its presentation. Desktop, phone, keyboard and large-text checks were run. Saves, recovery tools, currencies, normal conveyor rules and helper behavior are preserved.
Thank you for helping us make the shop easier to run. Enjoy your 10 rubies—and please keep the supplier’s herb pouch away from the finished bottles.

entries.title: An overnight order and a refreshed workshop
notes: Welcome back! This letter collects the changes since our October 22 mail, including the workshop update prepared on October 25. Your gift is 10 rubies; earlier mail gifts remain available if you have not claimed them.

The workshop: original Potion Maker artwork and typography now bring back the parchment coin display, conveyor gears and chains, quest portraits, menu icons, potion levels and brewing controls. Phone and desktop layouts, cauldron contents and character positioning have been adjusted to fit the scene.

Brewing feedback: original bubbles, boiling, splashes and enhancement success/failure effects are back, alongside chest-opening animation, reward reveals and the original progress-gauge artwork. Reduced-motion settings remain respected.
Music and sound: the original main theme and action sounds accompany brewing, selling, quests, helpers and menus. Music and sound have separate switches and volume controls.

Conveyor and helpers: belt movement stays constant as emission increases. Base emission upgrades range from 1 to 20 materials per second, supported fairy bonuses apply, and an empty cauldron is capped at 3 per second after bonuses. The old slowdown setting has been removed. Pushcats pause when the cauldron is empty or its potion cannot be enhanced further; their bodies stay in place while paws reach for ingredients.

The Shop: an Enhancement Pack offers 5 enhancement boosts and 3 protection boosts for 3 rubies. Ruby, ticket and gold bundles use earned game currencies; ticket/ruby exchanges keep the same value of 10 tickets to 1 ruby, and gold quotes follow permanent progression. The separate Bank has been removed.

New journeys: Dolbur now has expedition chapters for tiers 1–5, with Life, Mana and Stamina routes. Completed reports join the Story journal. Dispatch information makes costs, replacing a visitor order, guaranteed rewards and chance rewards clearer; existing trips retain their saved outcomes.

Costumes and characters: more recovered animated Pio and Tia outfits are available, grouped into their costume families. Pio also has a fan-made sundress outfit. Character dialogue and expressions have received fixes, and arrival/story conversations focus on the current speaker above the dialogue.

The potion book: choose Potions or Materials on entry, switch families along the left, and scroll through the book’s details. Potion entries combine original notes, expanded lore and customer reviews; materials explain their origins and brewing roles with supplier notes. Each potion’s extra Pio/Tia commentary stays hidden as ??? until MAX. The letter-tier ingredients are treated as letters, not fruit.

Achievements and fairies: the original achievement set is included, with exploration requirements adapted to remake expeditions. Achievement chains show the current tier in place of earlier steps. Potion mastery has individual titles and descriptions. Fairy pages explain current-level abilities, preview unowned companions and identify unsupported effects.

Menus and settings: shared original frames, title cards and section icons now tie together the Shop, book, achievements, fairies and other menus. Settings retain the original pill-style controls while adding volume, dark mode, dialogue and text-size options. The separate animations section has been removed.

Saving: the save page separates on-device saving and named slots from backup/transfer tools and recovery. Downloaded saves, codes, import previews and pre-import backups remain available. Autosave and older saves remain supported; export a backup when moving browsers or devices.

Potion commissions: Neet, Luke and Daisy have clearer customer cards, reasons for ordering, exact potion and minimum-level requirements, named rewards and delivery progress. You still choose one commission, pay no acceptance fee, face no deadline and deliver through normal brewing.

Tia and events: master all three beginner potions and finish Tia’s arrival conversation to unlock the new event loop, without the former entrance fee. Open Events on the right to join The Shop That Would Not Sleep, featuring Pio, Tia and Tirami’s oversized overnight order.

The overnight order: finish or skip the opening to start 15 minutes of gathering, followed by up to 60 seconds of packing. Catch event supplies alongside ordinary conveyor materials and store them in your pouch, even while brewing normally. Helpers ignore these supplies. With an empty cauldron, Brew uses one supply for one already-MAX event bottle; Deliver sends it to the order instead of selling it. Unused supplies expire when packing ends.

Event rewards: every 5 deliveries grants one protection, enhancement and selling boost. Every 50 deliveries earns a pending choice of an eligible featured outfit or one permanent Costume Voucher. Costume progress carries between runs. Vouchers use the coupon icon and can be saved for eligible animated event outfits; they cannot buy unrelated ticket-only costumes, defaults, static portraits or fan-made outfits. Existing free and owned outfits stay available.

Event results: C/B/A/S grades begin at 1/50/100/150 deliveries. Grades include all lower-grade rewards: 1/3/6/11 rubies in total, plus boosts, paid once per run; zero deliveries earns no grade reward. Results retain your deliveries, unused supplies, reward progress and personal best during the break. Story scenes can be replayed without restarting the timer or paying rewards again. Historical events are on hold for migration; saved Miracle Solution and earned outfits are retained.

Workshop upkeep: menus avoid unnecessary rebuilding while helpers work, finished chest displays stop refreshing needlessly, and returning to a tab respects Character-off. Duplicate embedded data and losslessly compressed costume textures reduce the download without replacing the artwork. Web updates now deploy automatically after publication.
Thank you for keeping the shop running! Claim your 10 rubies below, enjoy the new chapters and outfits—and leave a little time for sleep after that last delivery.

entries.title: Neet's story chapters are here
notes: Play Neet's tier-1–5 chapters; choose unlocked Life/Mana/Stamina routes to shape the story. Trip reports land in the Story journal; selling the route's potion shortens the trip. +10 rubies.

entries.title: New journeys, potion commissions, and a livelier shop
notes: Commissions: one order, three matching potions, no fee or deadline; every third adds a fairy while unmaxed fairies remain. Expeditions: 250 jobs (25 per visitor), dispatched from a visitor's page; dispatch costs gold, replaces the visitor's order, and continues while closed. Stamps redeem at the Stamp Exchange. +20 rubies.

entries.title: A helping paw for your potion shop
notes: Pushcat helpers: one ticket to summon, up to 8 cats, 60 working seconds before bonuses; they gather ingredients, tickets and Solution; timers survive reloads. +10 rubies.

entries.title: Get to know your fairy companions
notes: Fairy entries show exact current-level bonuses; unowned show a level-1 preview; 32 of 38 have working abilities and inactive ones say so. +10 rubies.

entries.title: A smoother shop and safer saves
notes: New settings (audio, speed, shortcuts, motion, dialogue, text size); 5-second autosave, backups, shareable saves; costumes cost 200 tickets, duplicates return 200. +10 rubies.
